text:
QUOTE: "Any `char*` the engine returns transfers ownership to the caller and must be released with `entropic_free()`." and "A `const char*` returned by the engine belongs to the handle and is valid only until the next call on that handle."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states both halves of the rule: a returned `char*` is owned by the caller and freed with `entropic_free`, and a `const char*` stays with the handle and is valid only until the next call.
